description: Deterministic-machine trace (VIRTUAL milliseconds, tools/dosmachine.py), designed against the original in that machine: one-player game, level 1 completed and level 2 started. Right then left, switch to the green bomb (left+right together), throw it at the girder structure, step back left under it so the falling counted bonus lands on the player (collected at about 21.4 s), dodge left out of the falling rubble, the level ends when the rubble settles (destruction 75 % of 50 %), the tally types out, fire, space starts level 2, a short walk, Escape ends the game. Host-timed replay under DOSBox-X is not expected to reproduce it.

steps.note: stand where the counted bonus will fall
